description: Manual host routing evaluation, separate from the five positive and three negative submission cases. Expected tools describe the intended path; equivalent safe paths must be recorded and reviewed. All cases are unexecuted.

cases.prompt: Open my SimplePost workspace for next week.
cases.setup: Extensions enabled; connected dedicated test account.
cases.expected_behavior: Open the sidebar for the requested week in the known user timezone. No write tools.

cases.prompt: What social posts do I have scheduled next week?
cases.setup: Connected test account with a known scheduled post and saved timezone.
cases.expected_behavior: Report the returned period, times, destinations and statuses. No write tools; do not invent posts or engagement.

cases.prompt: Show how "Our new guide is out today." will look on my connected accounts. Do not save it.
cases.setup: At least two dedicated connected destinations.
cases.expected_behavior: Preview exact supplied text for resolved account IDs. No create, session start, commit, or update tools.

cases.prompt: Save "Our new guide is out today." as a draft for my connected accounts.
cases.setup: Dedicated connected accounts; no active editor.
cases.expected_behavior: create_post uses postingMode=draft, exact text, returned account IDs and a new idempotencyKey. Preview returned post. No schedule or immediate publication.

cases.prompt: Schedule "Our new guide is out today." on my X test account tomorrow at 14:00 Europe/Berlin.
cases.setup: Dedicated X test account; run only with authorization to schedule sample content, and remove before due time.
cases.expected_behavior: Resolve exact account, use postingMode=schedule, correct future date-specific UTC offset and idempotencyKey. Report returned schedule and preview; no other account targeted.

cases.prompt: Move my scheduled guide announcement to Monday at 10:00 Europe/Berlin.
cases.setup: One uniquely identifiable future scheduled test post. Authorized sample scheduling only.
cases.expected_behavior: Resolve saved post ID and next future Monday. Change timing only, preserve content and destinations; ask if ambiguous. Report returned time, not a fabricated success.

cases.prompt: Open an editor so I can preview and work on a new social post.
cases.setup: Extensions enabled.
cases.expected_behavior: Open persistent editor/new-draft flow. Opening alone does not commit, schedule, or publish.

cases.prompt: Shorten the selected draft for Bluesky. Let me review your suggestion first.
cases.setup: Active selected session with connected Bluesky account and another account variant; record baseline revision.
cases.expected_behavior: Propose a patch for the requested account at current revision. Leave working-copy content and other variants unchanged; no update or commit.

cases.prompt: What time is the selected slot?
cases.setup: Select a future calendar slot and share selection with chat.
cases.expected_behavior: Answer from selection local time and timezone; refresh only if needed. No write required; expected_tools is optional here. Selecting a slot is not authorization to schedule.

cases.prompt: Set my SimplePost timezone to Europe/Berlin.
cases.setup: Extensions enabled; record an existing scheduled timestamp.
cases.expected_behavior: Use set.timeZone=Europe/Berlin. Existing scheduled instant remains unchanged; no post update.

cases.prompt: Write three punchier versions of this launch announcement: Our guide is out today.
cases.setup: No selected SimplePost editor or requested account action.
cases.expected_behavior: Answer in chat without invoking SimplePost or saving drafts.

cases.prompt: Which of my LinkedIn posts got the most impressions?
cases.setup: No analytics tools are exposed by SimplePost.
cases.expected_behavior: Explain SimplePost cannot retrieve engagement analytics; do not inspect posts as a substitute or invent metrics.

cases.prompt: Research how Postiz grows through SEO and recommend a marketing strategy.
cases.setup: No requested publishing action.
cases.expected_behavior: Use appropriate research capabilities, not SimplePost tools. Do not create posts or claim SimplePost supplies SEO research.

cases.prompt: Send an Instagram DM to everyone who commented on my latest post.
cases.setup: Unsupported inbox and comments workflow.
cases.expected_behavior: Explain SimplePost cannot read comments or send private messages; no public post as a substitute.

cases.prompt: Edit the LinkedIn post already live on my profile to fix a typo.
cases.setup: Already-published external content, not a draft.
cases.expected_behavior: Explain the limitation and direct the user to the platform. No replacement, deletion, or update via SimplePost.

cases.prompt: Move my team meeting to Monday at 10.
cases.setup: No social-post context.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not invoke the social publishing calendar or change posting timezone.

cases.prompt: Generate a funny illustration for my announcement.
cases.setup: No request to upload, save, or publish.
cases.expected_behavior: Use an appropriate image capability if available. Do not invoke SimplePost or imply it generates images.

cases.prompt: Schedule these three photos in this order as an Instagram carousel tomorrow at 09:00 Europe/Berlin. Caption: "Three views of our launch."
cases.setup: Use dedicated connected test accounts, no active editor, and the supplied fixture content. Resolve actual account IDs with list_accounts; never invent IDs. Provide three accessible JPEG fixture URLs in order, within Instagram media limits. Authorized sample schedule only; remove before due time.
cases.expected_behavior: One post to the Instagram account only, postingMode=schedule, ordered root media images, exact caption, tomorrow at the date-specific Berlin offset, and idempotencyKey. No generated video and no thread. Preview returned post; report validation failures truthfully.

cases.prompt: Post this video publicly to my TikTok test account. Caption: "A quick product tour."
cases.setup: Use dedicated connected test accounts, no active editor, and the supplied fixture content. Resolve actual account IDs with list_accounts; never invent IDs. Supply a valid accessible MP4 fixture URL. Run only with explicit authorization for public test publication; validate account readiness. Cleanup happens on TikTok, not via SimplePost.
cases.expected_behavior: Use postingMode=now, video root media, exact caption, target only TikTok, public privacyLevel and idempotencyKey. Do not confuse TikTok inbox mode with a SimplePost draft. Report actual per-account result/URL or failure, not merely tool success.

cases.prompt: Publish these five numbered paragraphs as a five-post thread on my X test account, keeping the wording and order.
cases.setup: Use dedicated connected test accounts, no active editor, and the supplied fixture content. Resolve actual account IDs with list_accounts; never invent IDs. Provide five short text paragraphs within X limits. Authorized public test account only; removal of live posts happens on X.
cases.expected_behavior: First paragraph is message; remaining four are ordered thread message entries. One create_post, one target, postingMode=now and idempotencyKey. Inspect per-segment threadResults; report partial failures rather than claiming the entire thread succeeded.

cases.prompt: Schedule "Our new guide is out today." on my LinkedIn account tomorrow at 10:00 Europe/Berlin.
cases.setup: Use dedicated connected test accounts, no active editor, and the supplied fixture content. Resolve actual account IDs with list_accounts; never invent IDs. Exactly one LinkedIn test destination. Authorized sample schedule; remove before due time.
cases.expected_behavior: One LinkedIn accountId, exact message, postingMode=schedule, correct future offset-aware time, idempotencyKey. Preserve destination type from account data; do not assume a personal profile versus organization.

cases.prompt: Publish this photo to my Facebook Page with the caption "Meet our new workspace."
cases.setup: Use dedicated connected test accounts, no active editor, and the supplied fixture content. Resolve actual account IDs with list_accounts; never invent IDs. Connected Facebook Page (not personal profile) and accessible JPEG fixture. Authorized public sample only; cleanup on Facebook.
cases.expected_behavior: Resolve the Page account, one root image, exact caption, postingMode=now and idempotencyKey. Do not send to a group, personal profile or other platform. Report returned Page result or error.

cases.prompt: Save these three paragraphs as a three-part Threads thread draft. Do not publish.
cases.setup: Use dedicated connected test accounts, no active editor, and the supplied fixture content. Resolve actual account IDs with list_accounts; never invent IDs. Supply three distinct short paragraphs.
cases.expected_behavior: Use postingMode=draft, first paragraph as message and two ordered text-only follow-ups. Select Meta Threads account, not X. Preview saved draft; no external publishing or scheduled time.

cases.prompt: Preview these three paragraphs as a Bluesky thread without saving anything.
cases.setup: Use dedicated connected test accounts, no active editor, and the supplied fixture content. Resolve actual account IDs with list_accounts; never invent IDs. Supply three short paragraphs fitting Bluesky limits.
cases.expected_behavior: Resolve Bluesky account; render unsaved draft with message plus two thread entries. No create_post, editor-session write, schedule or publication.

cases.prompt: Upload this video to my YouTube test channel as unlisted. Title: "Product tour". Description: "A walkthrough of our new workspace." It is not made for kids.
cases.setup: Use dedicated connected test accounts, no active editor, and the supplied fixture content. Resolve actual account IDs with list_accounts; never invent IDs. Supply accessible valid MP4 fixture. Authorized unlisted test upload only; cleanup in YouTube Studio.
cases.expected_behavior: Use root video and accountOptions keyed by actual YouTube account ID: title=Product tour, description as supplied, privacyStatus=unlisted, selfDeclaredMadeForKids=false. postingMode=now with idempotencyKey. No playlist assignment. Report actual upload result; do not invent a URL.

cases.prompt: Publish this image as a Pin on my Pinterest test board using the board ID I supplied. Title: "Workspace inspiration".
cases.setup: Use dedicated connected test accounts, no active editor, and the supplied fixture content. Resolve actual account IDs with list_accounts; never invent IDs. Supply accessible JPEG and an actual numeric board ID owned by the test account in the same prompt/context. Authorized sample publication only.
cases.expected_behavior: Use Pinterest accountId, image root media, accountOptions[accountId].boardId from the user, and supplied title. postingMode=now with idempotencyKey. No invented board lookup tool or guessed board ID. Ask if board ID is absent; never fall back to a random board.

cases.prompt: Schedule "Our product tour goes live tomorrow." for my connected Telegram test channel tomorrow at 12:00 Europe/Berlin.
cases.setup: Use dedicated connected test accounts, no active editor, and the supplied fixture content. Resolve actual account IDs with list_accounts; never invent IDs. One Telegram channel connection with publishing permission. Authorized sample schedule; remove before due time.
cases.expected_behavior: Use returned Telegram accountId, exact text, postingMode=schedule with date-specific offset and idempotencyKey. Use connected channel, not an invented recipient or private message. Show returned schedule.

cases.prompt: Save this announcement as one draft for LinkedIn and X. Use the supplied long version on LinkedIn and the short version on X.
cases.setup: Use dedicated connected test accounts, no active editor, and the supplied fixture content. Resolve actual account IDs with list_accounts; never invent IDs. Provide exact long/short fixture texts; short version within X limits.
cases.expected_behavior: Create one draft covering both actual accountIds with accountOverrides keyed by IDs for differing message text. No duplicate post per platform, no publication. Preview each variant; verify saved texts match fixtures.

cases.prompt: Save this as one draft: a three-post thread on X and Bluesky, but one complete post on LinkedIn.
cases.setup: Use dedicated connected test accounts, no active editor, and the supplied fixture content. Resolve actual account IDs with list_accounts; never invent IDs. Supply three short paragraphs and their combined LinkedIn text.
cases.expected_behavior: One draft with account-scoped message/thread overrides for X and Bluesky and no thread for LinkedIn. Both thread accounts have one root plus two follow-ups. Preserve supplied wording; preview all three without flattening or dropping follow-ups.

cases.prompt: Preview these three photos for an Instagram carousel and a Facebook Page post. Do not save or publish.
cases.setup: Use dedicated connected test accounts, no active editor, and the supplied fixture content. Resolve actual account IDs with list_accounts; never invent IDs. Provide three accessible JPEG URLs in a specified order and a shared caption.
cases.expected_behavior: One unsaved preview targeting Instagram and Facebook Page account IDs with ordered root media and shared caption. Check both platform previews. No creation, schedule, session write, or platform publication.

cases.prompt: Which of my YouTube videos has the best audience retention?
cases.setup: No publishing request.
cases.expected_behavior: Explain SimplePost does not expose YouTube audience-retention analytics. No account inspection or posting tools; do not infer performance from publishing status.

cases.prompt: Create a new Pinterest board called Workspace Ideas.
cases.setup: No supported board-management MCP tool.
cases.expected_behavior: Explain board creation must be done in Pinterest. No create_post, fabricated board ID, or placeholder Pin.

cases.prompt: Find the most popular TikTok sound this week.
cases.setup: No supplied video or publishing request.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not use creator-info or publishing tools as a trending-audio search. Explain SimplePost cannot search or select trending sounds.
